items.stem: Are there communities in your neighbourhood whose ancestors might have come to India centuries ago and made it their home? Have a class discussion on what their experience may have been.
items.answer:  Yes, in my neighbourhood, there are communities whose ancestors migrated to India centuries ago and eventually made it their home. items.stem: Identify similar values in any story or local tradition etc. known to you. You could ask your guardians or relatives too. Collect these stories and create a class manuscript. You could include illustrations.

items.stem: A powerful southern king commands a vast maritime empire. items.stem: Discuss the linguistic and spiritual ties between ancient Iranian Zoroastrianism and Indian Vedic traditions.
items.answer:  Ancient Zoroastrianism and Vedic traditions share incredibly deep spiritual roots, notably their mutual belief in a supreme cosmic order and the immense importance of sacred fire rituals. items.stem: Analyse the peaceful integration of Arab merchants into southern Indian society.
items.answer:  Unlike violent foreign conquerors, Arab merchants arrived peacefully on India’s western coast from the seventh century to conduct spice trade. items.stem: Evaluate the unique cultural fusion represented by the Siddi community in modern India.
items.answer:  Brought to India tragically as enslaved people, the Siddi community of African descent represents a remarkable cultural fusion.
